_what: PT-CAP8 S0 whole-.text relocation-field census of the clean EN exe against the cap manifests' byte extents. Every field of every cataloged array, covered or not; the uncovered ones carry a liveness verdict. Fields themselves: tools/data/cap_reloc_hits.json.
_baseline_why: Uncovered NON-dead fields of the v0.2.2 arrays. state=open means PT-CAP8 S1 still owes the patch; --check goes red on any uncovered live field NOT listed here, on a listed field that is now covered (flip it to closed with --rescan), and, under --strict, on any open one. by_design = a save/load block size that stays vanilla under the trailer design (PT-CAP8 S3), never owed a patch.
